01 · The calibre

V-1: hand-wound, and finished by hand.

Eleven bridges, cut and bevelled here. Geneva stripes, polished anglage, screws blued over a flame to the colour of the hands. It beats slowly, on purpose: a slower balance keeps its oil longer.

03 · The bench

Three watchmakers, one room, no line.

Every Reference 01 is assembled from start to finish by one of us, and the name on the servicing book is the name of the hands that built it. On Saturdays the bench is open: come and watch a balance go in.

  • Aurel Veyrefounder · calibre & assembly
  • Lise Monnierbridges, anglage, bluing
  • Jonas Perretregulation & the servicing bench

04 · The servicing book

Every watch we make has a page.

The book holds each serial number, who built it, and every service since. Bring a Reference 01 back in any year and we open its page. We also take other makers' hand-wound calibres, quoted on the bench.

Recommended every 6 to 8 years · two-year warranty on every service

05 · Visit

Chemin de la Combe 14, up the hill from the lake.

Twenty minutes from Le Sentier station, free parking by the door. Visits to see a piece or hand in a watch are by appointment on weekdays; on Saturdays the bench is simply open.
